agentflow.source:
---
title: Review workflow
---
agentflow-beta LR
connector store["Object store"]
store@{ endpoint: "https://example.invalid/data", protocol: http }
global
  shared["Policy guide"]@{ shape: refdoc }
end
flow team["Review team"]
  brief["Request"]@{ shape: input }
  flow worker["Worker"]
    read["Read input"]@{
      shape: tool
      connectorRef: store.read
      policy:
        retries: 2
        enabled: true
        tags: [safe, deterministic]
        constructor: ignored
      instruction: "Display data, never execute it."
    }
    gate["Ready?"]@{ shape: decision }
    read edge1@--> gate
    gate -- no --> read
    read -.- shared
  end
  worker@{ view: collapsed }
  publish["Publish"]@{ shape: action }
  brief --> read
  gate --x publish
end
edge1@{ instruction: "Only after validation" }

sequence.source:
---
title: Dashboard sign-in
---
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor User
  participant App
  participant IdP as Identity provider
  participant API
  User->>App: Open dashboard
  App->>IdP: Authorization request
  IdP-->>App: ID token + access token
  App->>API: GET /reports (Bearer token)
  alt token valid
    API-->>App: 200 report data
  else token expired
    API-->>App: 401 Unauthorized
  end
  Note over App,API: Tokens refresh silently before expiry
  App-->>User: Render charts
